mainTopic: רבי and רבנן on waving communal שלמים; רבי שמעון's three offerings and their סמיכה and תנופה; who does the waving
overview: The גמרא first gives two more ways to explain the מחלוקת between רבי and רבנן about waving the communal שלמים after slaughter. רב פפא says everyone holds דון מינה ומינה, and רבי waves the whole animal because the whole animal is a gift to the כהן. רבינא says everyone holds דון מינה ואוקי באתרה, and רבנן wave only the breast and thigh because of the extra word ״שלמיהם״. Then the גמרא quotes רבי שמעון's משנה. Three offerings, שלמי יחיד, שלמי ציבור and אשם מצורע, each need two of three מצוות: סמיכה, תנופה while alive, and תנופה after slaughter. The גמרא tries three times to use a קל וחומר to add the missing מצוה to each offering. Each attempt is blocked: twice by a limiting word in the פסוק (״אֹתָם״ and ״אֹתוֹ״), and once by a tradition that only two communal offerings get סמיכה. Finally a ברייתא teaches that one partner waves for all of the partners, and a כהן waves for a woman or for someone who sends his offering from overseas.

steps.title: רב פפא: everyone learns all details, and רבי's reason is the gift to the כהן
steps.stepSummary: רב פפא says the מחלוקת is not about how to learn one case from another. Everyone holds דון מינה ומינה. רבי's reason for waving the whole communal animal is that you wave whatever goes to the כהן.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב פפא said: Everyone agrees that when we learn one case from another, we take all the details from the source case. רבי's reason is this: do it here like it is done there. Just as there, the part that is a gift to the כהן is waved, so too here, the part that is a gift to the כהן is waved.
steps.whatsHappening: רב פפא gives a new explanation of the מחלוקת between רבי and רבנן about what gets waved after the communal שלמים are slaughtered.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Earlier, the גמרא suggested that the two sides argue about the method of learning one case from another. רב פפא says they don't: both use דון מינה ומינה. רבי simply reads the source differently. With individual שלמים, the breast and thigh are waved because they go to the כהן. The whole communal שלמים goes to the כהנים, so the whole animal is waved.

keyTerms.meaning: Learn from it and from it: when learning one case from another, take all the details from the source case
A gift to the כהן (the parts of an offering given to the כהנים)
There / here (the source case and the case being learned)

steps.confusionAlert: Don't think רבי holds a different method of learning here. According to רב פפא, רבי and רבנן use the same method. The difference comes from what רבי sees as the key feature of the source case: whatever goes to the כהן gets waved.

phrases.english: Rav Pappa said:

phrases.aramaic: דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא דּוּן מִינַּהּ וּמִינַּהּ הוּא,
phrases.english: Everyone holds it is "infer from it and from it,"
phrases.notes: When you learn one case from another, you copy all the details from the source case too.

phrases.english: and this is Rebbi's reason: like there,
just as there, the item that is a gift to the kohen [is waved],
phrases.notes: "There" means individual שלמים, where the breast and thigh go to the כהן.

phrases.english: so too here, the item that is a gift to the kohen [is waved].

steps.triggerLanguage: רַב פָּפָּא אָמַר: דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא דּוּן מִינַּהּ וּמִינַּהּ הוּא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Offers another explanation of the מחלוקת between רבי and רבנן, replacing the earlier suggestion from before this section
steps.terutzResolutionType: Re-explains the root of the מחלוקת: both sides share one method, and the difference is in the logic applied
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The מחלוקת depends on דון מינה ומינה versus דון מינה ואוקי באתרה
steps.terutzMaskana: Everyone holds דון מינה ומינה; רבי waves the whole communal animal because the whole thing is a gift to the כהן

steps.title: רבינא: everyone keeps details in place, and רבנן learn from the extra word
steps.stepSummary: רבינא says the opposite of רב פפא: everyone holds דון מינה ואוקי באתרה. רבנן limit the waving to breast and thigh because ״שלמיהם״ is a ריבוי.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבינא said: Everyone agrees that we learn from the source case but keep the details according to the case's own place. רבנן's reason is that the word ״שלמיהם״, 'their peace offerings,' is an inclusion.
steps.whatsHappening: רבינא gives another explanation of the same מחלוקת, the reverse of רב פפא's.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to רבינא, both sides use דון מינה ואוקי באתרה. On its own, that method would not copy the breast-and-thigh detail onto the communal offering. רבנן get that detail from a separate source: the plural word ״שלמיהם״ includes communal שלמים, so they too wave only the breast and thigh.

keyTerms.meaning: Learn from it, but set it in its own place: learn the main rule, but take the details from the new case itself
An inclusion: an extra word that adds another case to the law
Their peace offerings (a plural word in the פסוק)

steps.whyThisMatters: רב פפא and רבינא show that a single מחלוקת can be explained from opposite directions. Either way, the argument is not about the method of learning.

phrases.english: Ravina said:

phrases.aramaic: דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא דּוּן מִינַּהּ וְאוֹקֵי בְאַתְרַהּ,
phrases.english: Everyone holds "infer from it, but set it in its own place,"
and this is the Rabbis' reason:
"Their peace offerings" is an inclusion.
phrases.notes: ויקרא 7:34. The plural word is read as including communal שלמים, so they also wave just the breast and thigh.

steps.triggerLanguage: רָבִינָא אָמַר, דְּכוּלֵּי עָלְמָא דּוּן מִינַּהּ וְאוֹקֵי בְאַתְרַהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the mirror image of רב פפא's explanation
steps.terutzResolutionType: Re-explains the root of the מחלוקת: both sides share one method, and the difference comes from an extra word in the פסוק
steps.terutzHavaAmina: רבנן limit the waving because of their method of learning
steps.terutzMaskana: Everyone holds דון מינה ואוקי באתרה; רבנן limit the waving to breast and thigh because of the ריבוי of ״שלמיהם״
steps.whatToRemember: רב פפא: everyone holds דון מינה ומינה, and רבי waves whatever is a gift to the כהן. רבינא: everyone holds דון מינה ואוקי באתרה, and רבנן learn from the ריבוי ״שלמיהם״.

steps.title: רבי שמעון: three offerings, each needing two of three מצוות
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה. רבי שמעון lists three offerings that each need two out of three מצוות.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי שמעון says: Three types of offerings require three מצוות. Two of them apply to each one, and the third does not. These are the three: individual peace offerings, communal peace offerings, and the guilt offering of a מצורע.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves on to a new part of the משנה, where רבי שמעון gives a general list. This sets up the details that come in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The three מצוות are סמיכה, תנופה while alive, and תנופה after slaughter. Each offering has exactly two of them, but not the same two. The next step spells out which two belong to which offering. The communal שלמים here are the two lambs brought with the שתי הלחם on שבועות.

keyTerms.meaning: Types, kinds
Require
Peace offerings brought by an individual
Peace offerings brought by the community
The guilt offering brought by a מצורע when he becomes pure

phrases.english: Rabbi Shimon says:
Three types require three מצוות,
two in each one,
and the third is not in them,
phrases.notes: Each offering is missing one of the three, but a different one for each.

phrases.english: and these are they:
individual peace offerings,
communal peace offerings,
and the guilt offering of a metzora.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן אוֹמֵר: שְׁלֹשָׁה מִינִין טְעוּנִין שָׁלֹשׁ מִצְוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves the רבי and רבנן discussion and quotes the next part of the משנה
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Three offerings each require two of the three מצוות‎: סמיכה, תנופה alive, and תנופה slaughtered

steps.title: Which two מצוות each offering needs
steps.stepSummary: The משנה spells out the list. שלמי יחיד need סמיכה and תנופה after slaughter. שלמי ציבור need תנופה alive and after slaughter. אשם מצורע needs סמיכה and תנופה alive.
steps.simpleTranslation: Individual peace offerings require leaning hands while alive and waving after slaughter, but no waving while alive. Communal peace offerings require waving both alive and slaughtered, but no leaning. The מצורע's guilt offering requires leaning and waving while alive, but no waving after slaughter.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה fills in the details of רבי שמעון's list and says which מצוה each offering lacks.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each offering is missing a different מצוה‎. שלמי יחיד lack תנופה while alive. שלמי ציבור lack סמיכה. אשם מצורע lacks תנופה after slaughter.

keyTerms.meaning: Leaning one's hands on the animal's head
Waving
Alive (while the animal is still living)
Slaughtered (after the animal is slaughtered)

steps.whatToRemember: שלמי יחיד: סמיכה and תנופה after slaughter. שלמי ציבור: תנופה alive and after slaughter, with no סמיכה. אשם מצורע: סמיכה and תנופה alive, with no תנופה after slaughter.

phrases.aramaic: זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵי יָחִיד טְעוּנִין סְמִיכָה חַיִּים,
phrases.english: Individual peace offerings require leaning hands while alive,
and waving when slaughtered,
but they have no waving while alive.

phrases.aramaic: זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵי צִבּוּר טְעוּנִין תְּנוּפָה חַיִּים וּשְׁחוּטִין,
phrases.english: Communal peace offerings require waving alive and slaughtered,
but they have no leaning.

phrases.aramaic: אֲשַׁם מְצוֹרָע טָעוּן סְמִיכָה וּתְנוּפָה חַי,
phrases.english: The metzora's guilt offering requires leaning and waving while alive,
but it has no waving when slaughtered.

steps.triggerLanguage: זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵי יָחִיד טְעוּנִין סְמִיכָה חַיִּים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the details of the general list in step 3
steps.mimraCoreRuling: שלמי יחיד: סמיכה and תנופה after slaughter; שלמי ציבור: תנופה alive and after slaughter; אשם מצורע: סמיכה and תנופה alive

steps.title: Why don't an individual's peace offerings need waving while alive?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא builds a קל וחומר: if שלמי ציבור need תנופה while alive even though they have no סמיכה, then שלמי יחיד, which do have סמיכה, should need it too.
steps.simpleTranslation: Let an individual's peace offerings need waving while alive, by a קל וחומר. Communal peace offerings don't need leaning while alive, and still they need waving while alive. Individual peace offerings do need leaning while alive. So shouldn't they surely need waving while alive?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the משנה's list. It argues that שלמי יחיד should get a third מצוה‎, תנופה while alive.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The argument treats סמיכה as a sign that an offering is more 'serious.' שלמי ציבור lack סמיכה but still get live תנופה. So שלמי יחיד, which have סמיכה, should get live תנופה even more. If this worked, the משנה's 'two out of three' list would fall apart.

keyTerms.meaning: An argument from a lighter case to a stricter one: if the lighter case has a rule, the stricter case surely has it
Waving parts of an offering (or the animal) back and forth before ה׳
The owner leaning his hands on the animal's head before it is slaughtered
Peace offerings brought by a single person
Communal peace offerings, the two lambs of שבועות
'Is it not logical?' This is the closing line of a קל וחומר

phrases.english: And let an individual's peace offerings
require waving while alive,
by a kal vachomer:
Just as communal peace offerings,
which do not require leaning while alive,
do require waving while alive,
then an individual's peace offerings,
which do require leaning while alive,
is it not logical that they require waving while alive!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְיִהְיוּ זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵי יָחִיד טְעוּנִין תְּנוּפָה חַיִּים, מִקַּל וְחוֹמֶר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the list in the משנה (step 4) by trying to add a missing מצוה to שלמי יחיד
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that שלמי יחיד need only סמיכה and תנופה after slaughter
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: קל וחומר from שלמי ציבור: they lack סמיכה yet get live תנופה, so שלמי יחיד, which have סמיכה, should get live תנופה too

steps.title: The word ״אֹתָם״ limits live waving to communal offerings
steps.stepSummary: The תורה wrote ״אֹתָם״ about the communal peace offerings to exclude individual peace offerings from live תנופה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The תורה limited it. About the communal peace offerings it says ״אֹתָם״, 'them.' The word 'them' comes to exclude an individual's peace offerings.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the קל וחומר. A word in the פסוק blocks it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A קל וחומר can't override what the פסוק itself limits. The word ״אֹתָם״ means 'these, and not others,' so live תנופה belongs only to שלמי ציבור. That leaves the משנה's list standing.

keyTerms.meaning: 'The Merciful One (the תורה) excluded.' A word in the פסוק narrows the rule
'Them.' Here it is read as limiting the rule to these offerings only
To exclude
Regarding, in the section about

steps.whyThisMatters: It shows a basic rule of learning: a word in the פסוק that limits a law is stronger than a logical קל וחומר.

phrases.english: The Merciful One excluded
regarding communal peace offerings,
"them"; the word "them"
comes to exclude an individual's peace offerings.
phrases.notes: The פסוק is ויקרא 23:20. The first ״אֹתָם״ quotes the פסוק, and the second one points to that word to explain it.

steps.triggerLanguage: מִיעֵט רַחֲמָנָא גַּבֵּי זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵי צִבּוּר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קל וחומר of step 5
steps.terutzResolutionType: A limiting word in the פסוק overrides the קל וחומר
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Logic would give live תנופה to שלמי יחיד as well
steps.terutzMaskana: ״אֹתָם״ limits live תנופה to שלמי ציבור only

steps.title: Why don't communal peace offerings need leaning?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא runs a קל וחומר the other way: שלמי יחיד have סמיכה even without live תנופה, so שלמי ציבור, which do have live תנופה, should need סמיכה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Let communal peace offerings need leaning, by a קל וחומר. Individual peace offerings don't need waving while alive, and still they need leaning. Communal peace offerings do need waving while alive. So shouldn't they surely need leaning?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the משנה again. This time it tries to add סמיכה to שלמי ציבור.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This time the 'serious' sign is live תנופה. שלמי יחיד lack it but still get סמיכה. So שלמי ציבור, which have live תנופה, should get סמיכה even more.

keyTerms.meaning: While still alive, before slaughter
Which do not require
Offerings of

phrases.english: And let communal peace offerings
require leaning, by a kal vachomer:
Just as an individual's peace offerings,
which do not require waving while alive,
do require leaning,
then communal peace offerings,
which do require waving while alive,
is it not logical that they require leaning?

steps.triggerLanguage: וְיִהְיוּ זִבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵי צִבּוּר טְעוּנִין סְמִיכָה, מִקַּל וָחוֹמֶר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A second, mirror-image קל וחומר against the משנה's list
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that שלמי ציבור have no סמיכה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: קל וחומר from שלמי יחיד: they lack live תנופה yet have סמיכה, so שלמי ציבור, which have live תנופה, should have סמיכה

steps.title: A tradition: only two communal offerings get leaning
steps.stepSummary: רבינא answers that there is a received tradition that only two communal offerings have סמיכה. So the קל וחומר cannot add more.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבינא said: We have a tradition that there are only two leanings on communal offerings.
steps.whatsHappening: רבינא answers the second קל וחומר by pointing to a known tradition.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Like the פסוק in step 6, a received tradition beats a קל וחומר. The tradition counts exactly two communal offerings with סמיכה, the שעיר המשתלח and the פר העלם דבר של ציבור. Since שלמי ציבור are not on that list, they get no סמיכה.

keyTerms.meaning: 'We have learned it as a tradition,' a received teaching rather than one learned from a פסוק
Two cases of leaning
On communal offerings

phrases.english: Ravina said:
We have a tradition of two leanings on communal offerings.
phrases.notes: He means only two, so no other communal offering, like these שלמים, gets leaning.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רָבִינָא: גְּמִירִי שְׁתֵּי סְמִיכוֹת בְּצִבּוּר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קל וחומר of step 7
steps.terutzResolutionType: A received tradition limits the law and overrides the קל וחומר
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Logic would give סמיכה to שלמי ציבור
steps.terutzMaskana: Only two communal offerings have סמיכה, so שלמי ציבור don't

steps.title: Why doesn't the מצורע's guilt offering need waving after slaughter?
steps.stepSummary: A third קל וחומר: שלמי יחיד get תנופה after slaughter even without live תנופה, so אשם מצורע, which has live תנופה, should get תנופה after slaughter too.
steps.simpleTranslation: Let the מצורע's guilt offering need waving after slaughter, by a קל וחומר. Individual peace offerings don't need waving while alive, and still they need waving after slaughter. The מצורע's guilt offering does need waving while alive. So shouldn't it surely need waving after slaughter?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the third item on the משנה's list, the אשם מצורע. The next step answers this.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The 'serious' sign here is live תנופה again. שלמי יחיד lack live תנופה but still get תנופה after slaughter. So אשם מצורע, which has live תנופה, should get תנופה after slaughter even more. If this argument held, the אשם מצורע would have all three מצוות.

keyTerms.meaning: The guilt offering a מצורע brings as part of becoming טהור
After it has been slaughtered
Alive (singular)
'And let it be,' the opening of the challenge

phrases.english: And let the metzora's guilt offering
require waving once slaughtered,
by a kal vachomer:
Just as an individual's peace offerings,
which do not require waving while alive,
do require waving once slaughtered,
then the metzora's guilt offering, which requires waving while alive,
is it not logical that it requires waving once slaughtered!

steps.triggerLanguage: וִיהֵא אֲשַׁם מְצוֹרָע טָעוּן תְּנוּפָה שָׁחוּט, מִקַּל וְחוֹמֶר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: The third parallel קל וחומר, now aimed at the אשם מצורע
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's ruling that אשם מצורע has no תנופה after slaughter
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: קל וחומר from שלמי יחיד: they lack live תנופה yet get תנופה after slaughter, so אשם מצורע, which has live תנופה, should get it after slaughter too

steps.title: The word 'it' excludes the leper's guilt offering from waving after slaughter
steps.stepSummary: The תורה wrote ״אֹתוֹ״ about שלמי יחיד to exclude אשם מצורע from תנופה after slaughter.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Merciful One limited it when speaking about an individual's peace offerings: 'it.' The word 'it' comes to exclude the leper's guilt offering.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the קל וחומר from step 9. It shows that a word in the פסוק blocks אשם מצורע from getting תנופה after slaughter.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 9 argued that אשם מצורע has live תנופה, so it should also need תנופה after slaughter, just like שלמי יחיד. The answer is that the פסוק about שלמי יחיד says ״אֹתוֹ״, meaning 'it' and only it. That limiting word stops the קל וחומר, the same way ״אֹתָם״ did in step 6.

keyTerms.meaning: excluded, limited
the Merciful One, meaning the תורה
'it', a limiting word in the פסוק
the guilt offering brought by a recovered מצורע

steps.whatToRemember: All three קל וחומר arguments (steps 5, 7, 9) are blocked. Two are stopped by a limiting word in the פסוק (״אֹתָם״ and ״אֹתוֹ״), and one by a received tradition.

phrases.english: The Merciful One excluded, regarding
the peace offerings of an individual: 'it.'
'It' comes to exclude the leper's guilt offering.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קל וחומר of step 9.
steps.terutzResolutionType: A limiting word in the פסוק (מיעוט) overrides the קל וחומר
steps.terutzHavaAmina: אשם מצורע should get תנופה after slaughter, because it has live תנופה and is stronger than שלמי יחיד.
steps.terutzMaskana: ״אֹתוֹ״ limits after-slaughter תנופה to שלמי יחיד, so אשם מצורע is excluded.

steps.title: Who waves for partners, for a woman, and for someone overseas
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא rules that one partner waves for all five, a כהן waves for a woman, and a כהן waves for someone who sends his offerings from overseas.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבנן taught: if five people brought one offering together, one of them waves for all of them. For a woman, the כהן waves for her. Likewise, for someone who sends his offerings from overseas, the כהן waves for him.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא with a new topic: who does the waving when the owner cannot, or when there are many owners.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Partners do not each need to wave. One partner can wave for the whole group. In the other two cases, a woman and an owner who is not there, the owner does not wave at all. The כהן does it on the owner's behalf.
